SCUNet: Practical Blind Image Denoising via Swin-Conv-UNet and Data Synthesis.
Kai Zhang, Yawei Li, Jingyun Liang, Jiezhang Cao, Yulun Zhang, Hao Tang,
Deng-Ping Fan, Radu Timofte, Luc Van Gool. Machine Intelligence Research 2023.
Original repository: https://github.com/cszn/SCUNet
Apache License, Version 2.0. Weights are unmodified.

ONNX conversion: Heliosoph/scunet-onnx on Hugging Face.
The supplied license and model card are retained separately.

ONNX Runtime Web 1.24.3: Microsoft Corporation. MIT License.

No implementation code or visual assets from denoise.pro, imgmend.com,
Teamzlab or Callculation are included in this distribution.
